title: Advance Purchase Rates for Crestline Seats
content:
**Seat pricing table — Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** The seat price of an advance seat is multiplied by the **advance purchase rate**, which follows the advance days of the seat charge. The rate acts on the seat price before it is rounded to the cent.

| Advance days of the seat charge | Advance purchase rate |
|---|---|
| 35 or more (early threshold) | 0.85 |
| At least 21 (advance threshold) and fewer than 35 | 0.9 |
| Fewer than 21 | 1 |

The advance days are whole calendar days counted to the segment's scheduled departure date. The seat charge concerned is the latest seat charge recorded for the segment, with the purchase date recorded on it.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Advance days | Rate |
|---|---|
| 35 | 0.85 |
| 34 | 0.9 |
| 21 | 0.9 |
| 20 | 1 |
| 0 | 1 |

*Worked figure (hypothetical).* A seat price of 45 dollars at 40 advance days becomes 38.25 dollars.
